sld-pipeline-v3.title: SLD pipeline v3
sld-pipeline-v3.notes: Datasets: upload Data/releases/2026-10-04/component-symbols-v4.zip, component-symbols-test-printed.zip and sld-sheets-v3.zip (unpacked) as the three datasets listed here. Kaggle has no Google Drive: with COMP_EPOCHS = 0 or SLD_EPOCHS = 0 the saved classifier (*.keras + class_names.json) and detector (sld_*.pt) must come from an attached Kaggle dataset (found by content). Add your models dataset slug to 'datasets' for such runs; none is attached by default because the default run trains both parts.
